canonical_title: DeepSeek V4 API peak/off-peak pricing increase
treatment: Repeat only for another material pricing revision, cancellation, effective-date change, or measured demand/availability impact.
known_facts: DeepSeek announced higher API pricing for V4 Pro and V4 Flash with peak and off-peak rates.
Reuters reports increases ranging from 50% to 1,100% depending on model, token type, and time of use.
The new pricing takes effect in mid-August 2026.
reinclude_only_if: DeepSeek changes or cancels the new rates.
There is credible evidence of significant demand, routing, or availability impact.
notes: Pricing is a separate hard delta from the V4 Pro GA model release.
